page-read-confirmations-label: Label for the read confirmations feature, used in navigation and panel headers.
page-read-confirmations-automation-actio: Label for the automation action that triggers a read confirmation request.
page-read-confirmations-request-info: Heading displaying the state of a read confirmation. $1 is the linked revision identifier (e.g. a timestamp).
page-read-confirmations-no-request-info: Shown when no read confirmation has been requested for the current page.
page-read-confirmations-grid-column-user: Column header for the user name in the read confirmations data grid.
page-read-confirmations-grid-column-read: Column header for the last read revision in the read confirmations data grid.
Column header for the date/time the user confirmed reading in the data grid.
page-read-confirmations-grid-column-stat: Column header indicating whether the user has confirmed reading in the data grid.
page-read-confirmations-pending-count: Shows the number of pending (unconfirmed) assignments. $1 is the count. {{plural|$1}}
page-read-confirmations-no-pending: Shown when there are no pending read confirmations for the current page.
page-read-confirmations-send-reminder: Label for the button that sends a reminder to users who have not yet confirmed reading.
page-read-confirmations-more-actions: Tooltip/title for the button that opens a menu with additional actions.
page-read-confirmations-edit-assignments: Label for the menu item that opens the dialog for editing read confirmation assignments.
page-read-confirmations-cancel-request: Label for the menu item that cancels the current read confirmation request.
page-read-confirmations-confirm-cancel-r: Confirmation dialog message shown before cancelling a read confirmation request.
page-read-confirmations-action-delete: Label for the delete action button in confirmation dialogs.
page-read-confirmations-action-cancel: Label for the cancel/dismiss action button in confirmation dialogs.
page-read-confirmations-action-confirm: Label for the confirm action button in confirmation dialogs.
page-read-confirmations-action-remind: Label for the remind action button in the send-reminder confirmation dialog.
page-read-confirmations-error: Generic error message shown when an API request fails.
page-read-confirmations-assign-instructi: Instruction text in the assignment dialog describing what the user should do.
page-read-confirmations-assign-users: Label for the field that lets the user select individual users to assign.
page-read-confirmations-assign-groups: Label for the field that lets the user select user groups to assign.
page-read-confirmations-assignment-dialo: Title of the dialog for setting read confirmation assignments.
page-read-confirmations-action-assign: Label for the save/submit button in the assignment dialog.
page-read-assignments-do-confirm-label: Label for the button a user clicks to confirm they have read the page.
page-read-assignments-has-confirmed-labe: Label shown when the user has already confirmed reading the page.
page-read-confirmations-confirm-confirma: Confirmation dialog message shown before a user confirms they have read the page.
page-read-confirmations-inspector-activi: Label for the revision input field in the workflow activity inspector.
Placeholder text for the revision input field in the workflow activity inspector, explaining the default behaviour when left empty.
Label for the page name input field in the workflow activity inspector.
page-read-confirmations-invalid-page-id: Error message returned by the API when the provided page ID is invalid.
page-read-confirmations-no-revision-foun: Error message returned by the API when no revision can be found for the given page.
page-read-confirmations-invalid-revision: Error message returned by the API when the provided revision ID is invalid.
page-read-confirmations-invalid-page: Error message returned by the API when the provided page is invalid.
page-read-confirmations-invalid-user: Error message returned by the API when the provided user is invalid.
page-read-confirmations-registered-users: Error message returned by the API when an anonymous user tries to confirm reading.
page-read-confirmations-user-not-assigne: Error message returned by the API when the user is not assigned to read the page.
page-read-confirmations-user-not-request: Error message returned by the API when the user has not been requested to read the specific revision.
page-read-confirmations-invalid-assignme: Error message returned by the API when the assignment data is not in the expected format.
Error message returned by the API when the assignment type is not one of the accepted values.
page-read-confirmations-revision-not-for: Error message returned by the API when the given revision does not belong to the given page.
page-read-confirmations-revision-too-old: Error message returned by the API when trying to set an older revision than the one currently requested.
page-read-confirmations-no-permission: Error message returned by the API when the actor lacks the required permission.
page-read-confirmations-no-valid-title: Error message returned by the API when a valid title cannot be constructed from the request parameters.
page-read-confirmations-no-revision-for-: Error message returned by the API when no revision can be found for the given title and revision ID combination.
log-name-ext-page-read-confirmations: Name of the special log that records page read confirmation actions.
log-description-ext-page-read-confirmati: Description of the special log that records page read confirmation actions.
logentry-ext-page-read-confirmations-con: Log entry for when a user confirms reading a page. $1 is the performer, $2 is the performer's username (for GENDER), $3 is the page link, $4 is the revision ID.
logentry-ext-page-read-confirmations-rem: Log entry for when a confirmation is removed by an editor. $1 is the performer, $2 is the performer's username (for GENDER), $3 is the page link, $4 is the revision ID, $5 is the username whose confirmation was removed.
logentry-ext-page-read-confirmations-ass: Log entry for when a read confirmation assignment is added. $1 is the performer, $2 is the performer's username (for GENDER), $3 is the page link, $4 is the assignment key, $5 is the assignment type.
logentry-ext-page-read-confirmations-una: Log entry for when a read confirmation assignment is removed. $1 is the performer, $2 is the performer's username (for GENDER), $3 is the page link, $4 is the assignment key, $5 is the assignment type.
logentry-ext-page-read-confirmations-req: Log entry for when a read confirmation is requested. $1 is the performer, $2 is the performer's username (for GENDER), $3 is the page link, $4 is the revision ID.
logentry-ext-page-read-confirmations-rem: Log entry for when a read confirmation request is removed. $1 is the performer, $2 is the performer's username (for GENDER), $3 is the page link.
page-read-confirmation-reminder-event: Display name of the NotifyMe notification event for read confirmation reminders.
page-read-confirmation-reminder-event-me: NotifyMe notification message sent to a user when a reminder is issued by a human actor. $1 is the username of the actor (for GENDER), $2 is the linked page name.
NotifyMe notification message sent to a user when a reminder is issued by a bot or automated process. $1 is the linked page name.
page-read-confirmations-confirm-remind-r: Confirmation dialog message shown before sending reminders to users who have not yet confirmed reading.
page-read-confirmations-reminder-sent: Success notification shown after reminders have been sent successfully.
page-read-confirmations-inspector-activi: Field label for selecting individual users as the audience for triggering read confirmation requests in the workflow activity inspector.
Field label for selecting user groups as the audience for triggering read confirmation requests in the workflow activity inspector.
page-read-confirmations-request-confirma: Label for the button to manually request read confirmations for a page.
Help text for the button to manually request read confirmations for a page.
page-read-confirmations-confirm-request: Confirmation message shown before sending read confirmation requests to users who have not yet confirmed reading.
page-read-confirmations-action-request: Label for the action button to request read confirmations for a page.
